description: The QGIS EPANET plugin exposes hydraulic and quality modelling through the processing interface and an installed English-language EPANET command-line executable. This resource is provided by Oslandia (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: GPL-2.0-or-later. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The instructions target QGIS 2-era dependencies and require a compatibility check on current systems. The page does not establish reuse or maintenance beyond the originating study or small project. For simulation, it can support model preparation or execution. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
